simple.meaning: עֲנָתוֹת (ʻĂnâthôwth) appears 15 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, and 2 more, beginning at Joshua 21:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲנָתוֹת (H6068) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲנָתוֹת through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord‡ The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”
the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.
The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.
Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
“Therefore Yahweh says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in Yahweh’s name, that you not die by our hand;’
There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’ ”
‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.” ’ ”

“So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’
I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels* A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. of silver.

definitions.full: H6068. Anathoth עֲנָתוֺת and ( 1Kin 2:26 ) עֲנָתֹת proper name Αναθωθ ; 1. location (compare goddess Anat , reference below foregoing); — Isa 10:30 ; 1Kin 2:26 ; Jer 1:1 ; 11:21-22 , 32:7-8 , 9 ; Josh 21:18 (P), 1Chr 6:45 ; Ezra 2:23 = Neh 7:27 ; 11:32 ; modern `Anâtâ , approximately 3 miles north-northeast from Jerusalem, compare Buhl Geogr. 175 GASm Geogr. 315. 2. masculine a. 1Chr 7:8 . b. Neh 10:20 .
